headline: Going Commando expands shared level code and core libraries
summary: Going Commando gains shared level routines, object-list helpers and core-library implementations for USA v1.01. The committed progress report remains at 5.75% matched code and does not measure these later batches. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: #200 adds 52 shared level functions and #204 adds 22 more.
#196, #201 and #205 add 28 shared game functions between them.
#198 includes memory allocation, exception handling and square-root library work.
#194 retains nine core matches, while bodies requiring inline assembly or lacking valid build placement are left out.
Near misses and catalogue defects remain recorded separately. Documentation proposal #202 closed without merging.
